author: hdprajwal
abstract: The local equivalent of Claude computer use on Hyprland/Wayland: an observe → reason → act → verify loop combining screen-capture (grim), gui-input-automation (wtype/ydotool), and hyprland-control (hyprctl). Includes coordinate calibration for scaled monitors, a shell-first rule, one-action-then-look discipline, and confirm-before-risky-actions safety. Verified on CachyOS + Hyprland.
